correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed GP(8,3) on sixteen vertices with 24 edges and computed every one of the 2^16 masks by induced component size, finding 6813 Ind2 faces, 15197 Ind3 faces and exactly 8384 relative faces. Read actual collapse_pairs.txt; independently replayed all 4192 distinct pairs (first 494→4590, last 36880→53264) against the changing full Ind3 face poset, verifying each lower face has exactly one present codimension-one coface, the upper is maximal, neither belongs to Ind2 and every deletion is legal. No invalid step; the final retained complex is EXACTLY Ind2. This is a literal sequence of elementary collapses, hence strong deformation retract and simple-homotopy equivalence, stronger than an Euler or rank agreement.
